entries.resolution: A run is a historical operation window containing multiple real attempts. Time continues, corpses and local consequences persist, and no rewind occurs.

LORE_BIBLE.md now locks the Night of Sarn as the playable finale of LITD2. The Long Assemblies and First Pact occur afterward and belong to historical epilogue/codex or explicitly post-campaign content.
Potions are scarce Remanence-compatible compounds acting on the living reconstructed body's biological reference state; they cannot resurrect or become universal medicine.

LITD_UNIVERSE_LIMITES_DU_VOILE.md now defines hard prohibitions, required conditions, scale, memory/perception constraints, corpse rules and an anti-contrivance test for every major supernatural event.

entries.problem: Several ancient civilizations risked appearing to exist only to deliver one useful Veil revelation each.
entries.resolution: Each of the seven civilizations now has a multi-century independent history, geography, economy, political institutions, social conflicts, arts, beliefs, technologies, non-supernatural historical errors, neighbors/exchange logic, decline and non-Veil legacy. Their Veil contact occurs only as a late consequence of pre-existing social and political contradictions. Their periods overlap and some knowledge circulates through trade, migration and inheritance rather than forming a neat revelation sequence.

Writer-facing canon defines continuous imprint, matter-based reconstruction, compatible anchors, measurable delay, single active continuity, non-retroactive binding, non-industrializability and strict prohibitions.
